documentation_scope: Early evaluation and foundational engine milestones, documentation only; goal paused.

attempts.title: Strata and ro99 evaluation
attempts.mechanism: Compare Qwen-specific Niko Strata execution with Laguna attention, routing, DFlash, and Q3 format support; select Poolside llama.cpp as the engine base.
attempts.result: Niko supplied memory tiering ideas and adapted IQ kernel code. ro99 was inspected for Laguna and tiered placement, but the E: README records its four-bit floor/native FP4 path as unsuitable for the requested Q3. Floatie uses Poolside llama.cpp commit 06f8cebd7fe728687be3d19f8bdedb70d75883af.
attempts.limits: Qwen 128k capability and roughly 30?38 tok/s around 50k were owner/session claims. No controlled, same-prompt Qwen/Laguna comparison or direct ro99 execution receipt was found in this family.

attempts.title: Run Laguna2.1 via Strata research essay
attempts.mechanism: Review Poolside backend support, SWA allocation, pinned experts, short DFlash blocks, confidence filtering, attention requantization, and multi-GPU regex balancing.
attempts.result: The full essay was reviewed; SHA256 ade039862d4352f00c97236f35636106d4bc063837012d17a460409b52abe957. The local engine implemented Poolside model support, owned host experts, compact SWA, and repaired Q8 DFlash. These receipts do not establish attention requantization, multi-GPU interleaving, or confidence-threshold optimization.
attempts.limits: Its external claims include 18?20 / 60?64 generation tok/s, 7.2?7.8% attention requantization gain, 58?23 tok/s with DFlash, and 6.8 ms extra verification cost. These are source claims on other machines. Its 512-cell SWA estimate, all-48-MoE description, vocabulary/FF dimensions, and 1M-context claim must not override actual GGUF metadata or local allocation evidence.

attempts.title: Initial hybrid engine build and artifact preparation
attempts.mechanism: Implement owned RAM experts, GPU caching, concurrent standard quantized CPU misses, a fused routed operator, GPU quantized prefill, local API, and DFlash.
attempts.result: Compilation and pinned model checks succeeded. Target: 48,428,911,520 bytes, SHA256 8a9ab3f8b3ff1723441cd251e873b295a7ef086d78dbae7515e5e27c8382b002. Initial profile: cache 3072 MiB, context 131072, batch 512, DFlash 4, and Q8 KV. Preparation contained no inference metric.
attempts.limits: The prepared-state receipt explicitly says inference/model initialization had not occurred. This foundation evolved substantially. Initial UI asset downloads failed TLS verification; the compiled API did not require the UI.

attempts.title: Initial near-full130278-token run
attempts.mechanism: Execute the initial hybrid API at context 131072, cache 3072 MiB, batch 512, DFlash 4, and Q8 KV.
attempts.result: Native log: 320.37 tok/s prefill, 1.76 tok/s generation, 52 output tokens, 0/204 draft tokens accepted. The owner reported all three codes recalled. A prior 130501-token run recorded 329.60 tok/s prefill and an invalid 1000000 tok/s generation figure from one output token timed at 0 ms.
attempts.limits: The matching log belongs to the Poolside hybrid installation; ro99 execution is not established. The owner?s original request/output token IDs were not preserved. This does not prove current-engine 128k speed. The reported comparison with Niko?s prefill has no same-prompt control here.

candidate_runs.checkpoint_order_correct: owner-reported; native log does not include output text

attempts.title: Initial request/launch interruptions
attempts.mechanism: Preserve early malformed API requests, an interrupted no-draft long prompt, and a build wrapper failure.
attempts.result: Two malformed JSON requests returned HTTP 500 parse error 101. A no-draft 131072-context attempt reached 5120 prompt tokens without a final timing receipt. A PowerShell 5.1 build invocation stopped on CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release output under ErrorActionPreference=Stop.
attempts.limits: Later wrapper exit code -1 lines alone do not prove crashes or OOM; many accompanied deliberate server stops. No OOM diagnosis is asserted. These failures are operational evidence, not speed comparisons.

attempts.title: 512-batch initial8k run
attempts.mechanism: Run an 8192-token prompt with cache 3072 MiB, batch 512, and drafting disabled.
attempts.result: 73.64 tok/s prefill / 9.49 generation. Thinking consumed the 80-token output cap before the checkpoint answer.
attempts.limits: The request hash and thinking mode differ from later explicit-BOS and 8064 comparisons. This run did not deliver a recall answer within the cap.

attempts.limits: Cached prefill cannot be compared with uncached runs. The answer request?s BOS handling was subsequently corrected.

attempts.result: 206.94 tok/s prefill / 9.46 generation. The beginning checkpoint was incorrect: MAPLE-42 / MAPLE-42 / VIOLET-89.

attempts.title: DFlash GGUF metadata repair
attempts.mechanism: Add the official 512-token window, all-SWA pattern, 128 RoPE dimensions, and no RoPE scaling without changing the draft tensor payload.
attempts.result: All 76 tensor descriptors and the 1,184,848,896-byte payload were preserved; payload SHA256 8437edb6262d450ba224ffa546ee986af0408405c305d874eb9e9ef2f7715339. Answer request: 197.07 / 2.57 tok/s and incorrect beginning code. Explicit BOS: 187.95 / 2.56 and correct codes. Both accepted only 2/298 draft tokens (0.67%).
attempts.limits: Metadata repair alone did not repair quantized-KV feature injection. No speedup is claimed; poor acceptance is retained as failure evidence.

controls.profile: Enabled for initial 2048 batch hybrid receipts (native logs); not established for short 512-batch/first-run.

attempts.title: Pinned expert RAM and5120MiB cache
attempts.mechanism: Register 41.91 GiB of expert RAM and enlarge cache 3072?5120 MiB; use batch 2048 and explicit BOS without drafting.
attempts.result: 257.05 tok/s prefill / 10.22 generation; all three codes correct. Pinning and a larger cache persisted in later mechanics.
attempts.limits: BOS, cache, pinning, and prior code differed together. The benefit of pinning is not isolated. 5120 MiB is a historical budget, not the latest decode budget.

attempts.title: Initial adaptive cache admission
attempts.mechanism: Cap old prefill history, decay heat by 0.97 per evaluated token, and permit one promotion per layer call.
attempts.result: 257.88 / 9.04 tok/s versus the preceding 257.05 / 10.22. Codes were correct. Adaptive history persisted; admission subsequently changed.
attempts.limits: This initial admission regression does not establish a regression in the current budgeted policy. Output tokens and expert work differ.

controls.profile: Enabled for initial 2048 batch hybrid receipts (native logs); not established for short 512-batch/first-run.

attempts.title: Initial compute/upload overlap
attempts.mechanism: Queue cache/GPU work while CPU expert misses compute.
attempts.result: 256.16 / 9.61 tok/s versus preceding adaptive 257.88 / 9.04. Codes and output token hashes match the adaptive control.
attempts.limits: Single sequential runs do not prove repeatability. The current overlap mechanism evolved further; no isolated sustained gain is established.

controls.profile: Enabled for initial 2048 batch hybrid receipts (native logs); not established for short 512-batch/first-run.

attempts.title: Explicit Windows stream submission
attempts.mechanism: Explicitly submit Windows CUDA transfer/compute queues before waiting.
attempts.result: 242.12 / 10.63 tok/s versus preceding overlap 256.16 / 9.61. Codes and output token hashes match. Entry-event wait declined in the profile, while prefill regressed. Current code retains submit_stream.
attempts.limits: Single sequential runs; CPU/GPU intervals overlap and must not be summed.

controls.profile: Enabled for initial 2048 batch hybrid receipts (native logs); not established for short 512-batch/first-run.

attempts.title: Bounded core streaming and grouped AVX2
attempts.mechanism: Bound GPU tiles to 4096 selections; use two 32-expert transfer banks, reuse admissions, group IQ CPU work across up to four tokens, and repair Hadamard draft KV injection.

evidence.purpose: Direct native evidence for settings or recorded timing.

attempts.result: The compiled checkpoint initially stopped before inference. Subsequent no-draft 8064-prompt runs measured 464.63 / 9.44 and 499.06 / 9.56 tok/s after Strata stopped. Codes were correct.
attempts.limits: Batch, context, cache, and kernels changed together; gains cannot be attributed individually. Output tokens differ. Shared GPU memory counters alone do not prove paging.

attempts.title: DFlash512working batch plus corrected injection
attempts.mechanism: Cap draft working batch at 512 independently of the target 8192 batch, alongside the corrected Hadamard quantized-KV feature injection.

evidence.purpose: Direct native evidence for settings or recorded timing.

attempts.result: 422.24 / 11.22 tok/s; 55/96 draft tokens accepted (57.29%), versus the earlier broken injection?s 2/298. All codes were correct.
attempts.limits: Recovery followed multiple changes and context reduction; this is not an isolated working-batch gain. Q8 draft KV works after correcting feature transformation; the essay?s F16-only recommendation is not established.

attempts.title: Throttle decode cache refresh
attempts.mechanism: Compute ordinary misses on CPU and refresh at most one expert per layer after 16 evaluated tokens.

evidence.purpose: Direct native evidence for settings or recorded timing.

attempts.result: 445.91 / 11.35 tok/s; 52/102 draft tokens accepted, correct codes. The 16-token refresh fallback remains; later budgeted admission overlaps further refreshes.
attempts.limits: The receipt?s nsys label does not prove a completed trace. Native Nsight failed because the ETW ReflexStatsTraceLoggingProvider required administrator privileges; an earlier launcher could not resolve the pwsh alias. No usable CUDA trace is established.

attempts.title: Prefill recency and Windows stream submit
attempts.mechanism: Apply per-token decay to prefill cache history and explicitly submit transfer/compute work on Windows.
attempts.result: 463.56 / 13.77 tok/s; 54/96 drafts accepted, all codes. Current source includes prefill recency/decay and stream submission.
attempts.limits: The previous budgeted receipt used a profiler launcher. Multiple mechanisms changed, preventing a causal comparison.

attempts.title: Bulk prefill atlas
attempts.mechanism: Stage a complete eligible layer atlas, upload the next layer, use four gather banks, and remove unhelpful GPU span capture.
attempts.result: 506.34 / 13.18 tok/s; 53/100 drafts accepted, correct codes. Current bulk paths retain atlas and fallback streaming mechanisms.
attempts.limits: Source and output tokens differ from the recency run. Generation did not improve in this single measurement.

attempts.title: Two alternating full-layer buffers
attempts.mechanism: Use two alternating layer atlases with direct matrix reads and a VRAM check; restore standard singleton CPU dots.
attempts.result: Initial result: 190.19 / 14.11 tok/s, 55/92 drafts accepted, all codes. Prefill copied 42791.48 MiB; copy interval 13470.54 ms and readback wait 25400.97 ms. Later phase memory addressed headroom; the two-atlas mechanism remains.
attempts.limits: The poor initial prefill result is preserved. Later success does not prove an isolated two-buffer benefit. Profiling intervals overlap.

attempts.title: Separate prefill/decode memory budgets
attempts.mechanism: Release oversized graph buffers, shrink expert cache during prefill, free layer atlases, then grow/populate the decode cache.

evidence.purpose: Direct native evidence for settings or recorded timing.

attempts.result: 361.55 / 14.82 tok/s; 55/92 drafts accepted. Native log: prefill cache 5120 MiB; decode cache 8192 MiB; 3137.11 MiB of hot experts uploaded during an 829.71 ms transition. Codes were correct.
attempts.limits: The preceding dual-layer run was 190.19 / 14.11, but binaries and memory state changed. The phase budgets are retained; these are historical rates.

attempts.title: Bound MMQ grids to actual expert groups
attempts.mechanism: Bound MMQ tile grids by the actual expert range and largest group; use dense MMQ for one expert.
attempts.result: 515.30 / 14.46 tok/s; warm repeat 514.89 / 12.08. Draft counts were 96/54 versus 100/53. Codes were correct. The production checkpoint?s mmq.cu hash 46671A59? establishes retention.
attempts.limits: Generation varied substantially and output tokens differ; 14.46 tok/s is not a demonstrated repeatable gain.

attempts.title: Replace entry host-event wait
attempts.mechanism: Replace the entry host-event wait with a CUDA stream dependency before mandatory metadata readback; measure host dispatch.
attempts.result: 493.98 / 12.05 tok/s; 54/96 drafts accepted, correct codes. The later fused-bulk deployment explicitly restored the measured host-event wait.
attempts.limits: No isolated matched control. Previous compact runs were 515.30 / 14.46 and 514.89 / 12.08. Dispatch instrumentation may remain independently of the rejected wait change.

attempts.title: Fuse GPU prefill gate/up projections
attempts.mechanism: Interleave gate/up uploads without enlarging the atlas, fuse prefill MMQ, reuse input scratch, and restore the host-event wait.
attempts.result: 511.11 / 12.07 tok/s; 55/96 drafts accepted, correct codes. Current source retains bulk_fused.
attempts.limits: Changes were combined; this measurement does not isolate fused GPU benefit or the wait restoration.

attempts.title: Compact GPU decode selections
attempts.mechanism: Pack cached GPU selections within each token while preserving CPU misses and routing weights.
attempts.result: 511.02 / 11.67 and warm 538.10 / 11.98 tok/s. Draft counts: 96/54 versus 100/53. GPU padding fell 67.7% and cached intervals fell 23%, but throughput did not improve. The candidate was archived; the checkpoint explicitly says retained=false.
attempts.limits: Warm/cold clocks and output tokens differ. A smaller GPU subinterval does not establish faster generation.

attempts.title: Restore production cache/decode baseline
attempts.mechanism: Remove compact decode/cost-aware admission candidates; keep diagnostics optional and disable them during the production run.
attempts.result: 509.66 / 12.22 tok/s; 55/96 drafts accepted, all codes. The checkpoint records source/binary hashes and then-healthy API. Explicit compact decode, cost-aware admission, and power-policy rejections were preserved.
attempts.limits: This is a historical baseline, not live performance. Outputs differ from candidates. Shared-memory 43770 MiB included 42912 MiB of registered experts; this does not prove paging.

attempts.title: Trim obsolete DFlash prefill feature injection
attempts.mechanism: Fuse and inject only target features still visible to the all-SWA draft?s 512-token window, using the proper model window accessor.

evidence.purpose: Direct native evidence for settings or recorded timing.

attempts.result: 705.72 / 11.51 tok/s; 53/100 drafts accepted, correct codes. Native log injected 512 rows and skipped 7548 obsolete rows, taking 506.07 ms.
attempts.limits: Historical baseline was 509.66 / 12.22 with other intervening changes. There is no isolated on/off control. The all-SWA guard is essential; not every model permits this trim.

attempts.title: Preserve original draft injection chunk alignment
attempts.mechanism: Trim the draft window while preserving original 512-row chunk boundaries and matrix shapes.
attempts.result: 718.13 / 11.58 tok/s; 53/100 drafts accepted, all codes. Actual output tokens match the preceding window-injection production run.
attempts.limits: Profiling, verbosity, and binaries differ from the preceding 705.72 / 11.51 run. Do not claim speedup from this one cross-profile comparison.
